'''Takor the Terrible''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] warlord living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Infamous for taking prisoners, only to throw them into the maw of the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]] to torture them, he was killed by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] individual in [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Takor the Terrible appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a bonus boss for the heroic quest "The Long Goodbye".
